run_pix2pix_training: run the pix2pix GAN training script with argparse CLI options for dataset, epochs, and batch size
run_training_with_hub_push: run pix2pix training and push the generator model to HuggingFace Hub after each epoch
run_training_with_mixed_precision: run pix2pix training with fp16 or bf16 mixed precision using the accelerate library
run_training_from_checkpoint: resume pix2pix training from a saved generator and discriminator checkpoint at a given epoch
review_weights_init_normal: review the weights_init_normal function that initializes Conv and BatchNorm2d layers with normal distribution
